def transform(grid):

    # Each horizontal pair on a top/bottom edge emits inward from its left cell.
    for r, dr in ((0, 1), (h - 1, -1)):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] == grid[r][c + 1]:
                rr = r + dr
                while 0 <= rr < h and out[rr][c] == bg:
                    out[rr][c] = ray_color
